description.sl: Opa Sepp pozna pokrajino od Karnijskih Alp do morja: gorovje in planote, pobočja, globeli in barja, loke ob Dravi in pritoki, ustje Zilje, gorska jezera, kotlina okoli Celovca, ravnina, obala, zalivi in plaže pri Gradežu in Lignanu, slikovite vasi in panorama vse do Julijskih Alp. Avstrijsko: die Au.
description.en: Opa Sepp knows the landscape from the Carnic Alps to the sea: mountain ranges and plateaus, slopes, ravines and bogs, the river meadows of the Drava and its tributaries, where the Gail flows in, mountain lakes, the Klagenfurt basin, the plain, the coast, bays and beaches at Grado and Lignano, picturesque villages and a panorama as far as the Julian Alps. Austrian: die Au.
description.it: Nonno Sepp conosce il paesaggio dalle Alpi Carniche al mare: catene montuose e altopiani, pendii, gole e torbiere, le golene della Drava e i suoi affluenti, la foce del Gail, i laghi alpini, il bacino di Klagenfurt, la pianura, la costa, baie e spiagge a Grado e Lignano, paesi pittoreschi e un panorama fino alle Alpi Giulie. In austriaco: die Au.

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
